method: Use the current-time predicted relative center and body heading as the three-variable local rectangle fit seed. Point-cloud geometry alone determines the objective; no pose-prior penalty or fixed heading. Bootstrap the first center from observed geometry and the existing co-moving heading assumption. Do not feed predictions back as measurements during missing detections.
validation: Synthetic geometry and causal timing tests; cached actual detections then actual detector/MATLAB replays; truth read only by a separate scorer after prediction hashes. Both captures are previously seen.
runtimeIsolation: Committed MATLAB sources copied to runtime_snapshot because another session is changing controller/error-bound files. No other workspace changes or CARLA server are touched.
objective: Capped nearest-face residual plus the existing weight-20 containment penalty; optional observed tangential symmetry residual. Three free pose variables initialized from the predicted pose. Geometry settings frozen before truth scoring.
expectedLimitations: Single-face tangent translation may be unobservable; a seed can choose a solution but cannot create information.
A local optimizer may follow a wrong initial basin.
Observed vehicle surfaces differ from a perfect rectangle.
